note: Luna Network HSM 7 firmware 7.9.0 notes (released July 2025; needs Luna HSM Client 10.9.0 or newer) list these mechanisms; the algorithms page (last updated 2026-04-15) gives firmware 7.9.0 or newer (https://thalesdocs.com/gphsm/luna/7/docs/network/Content/sdk/extensions/pqc/post_quantum_algorithms.htm). All names except CKM_EXTMU_ML_DSA are defined in the OASIS PKCS #11 v3.2 header (https://docs.oasis-open.org/pkcs11/pkcs11-spec/v3.2/os/include/pkcs11-v3.2/pkcs11t.h); CKM_EXTMU_ML_DSA was not found there (the last 3,078 characters of the header were not read). The 7.9.0 notes say wrapping-off of ML-DSA and ML-KEM keys is not supported; a later page for the USB HSM says wrapping works, not checked for the Network HSM. CMVP certificate 4684 (Thales Luna K7 Cryptographic Module, FIPS 140-3 level 3, active, latest update 2025-07-07) covers firmware 7.8.4 and 7.8.5 only and lists none of ML-DSA, ML-KEM, SLH-DSA, LMS or XMSS in its approved or allowed algorithm lists (https://csrc.nist.gov/projects/cryptographic-module-validation-program/certificate/4684); it does not cover the 7.9 firmware that adds ML-DSA and ML-KEM. The algorithms page links a CAVP entry but no certificate number was read, and neither page states whether these run in FIPS-approved mode.

Firmware 7.9.0 notes list both mechanisms; the algorithms page gives firmware 7.9.0 or newer (https://thalesdocs.com/gphsm/luna/7/docs/network/Content/sdk/extensions/pqc/post_quantum_algorithms.htm). Both names are defined in the OASIS PKCS #11 v3.2 header (https://docs.oasis-open.org/pkcs11/pkcs11-spec/v3.2/os/include/pkcs11-v3.2/pkcs11t.h). The 7.9.0 notes also add ECDH-P521-ML-KEM1024 cipher suites for cloning between application partitions. CMVP certificate 4684 (Thales Luna K7 Cryptographic Module, FIPS 140-3 level 3, active, latest update 2025-07-07) covers firmware 7.8.4 and 7.8.5 only and lists none of ML-DSA, ML-KEM, SLH-DSA, LMS or XMSS in its approved or allowed algorithm lists (https://csrc.nist.gov/projects/cryptographic-module-validation-program/certificate/4684); it does not cover the 7.9 firmware that adds ML-DSA and ML-KEM. The algorithms page links a CAVP entry but no certificate number was read, and neither page states whether these run in FIPS-approved mode.

The algorithms page lists LMS-HSS from firmware 7.8.9, 'fully compliant with the published standard', with the limit 'not being copyable, thus no backup and no HA replication are possible'. No PKCS #11 mechanism names appear on that page. CMVP 4684 lists no LMS (https://csrc.nist.gov/projects/cryptographic-module-validation-program/certificate/4684).

SLH-DSA is not mentioned on the Luna algorithms page or the 7.9.0 firmware notes read on 2026-10-22, so availability stays unknown. CMVP 4684 lists no SLH-DSA (https://csrc.nist.gov/projects/cryptographic-module-validation-program/certificate/4684).

XMSS is not mentioned on the Luna algorithms page or the 7.9.0 firmware notes read on 2026-10-22, so availability stays unknown. CMVP 4684 lists no XMSS (https://csrc.nist.gov/projects/cryptographic-module-validation-program/certificate/4684).
